title: Summary: Merging
objective: Merge a notes branch into main as a fast-forward, then print the newest subject and its parent count.
hint: Commit the README on main, switch to notes, add the second section, commit it, switch back to main, and git merge -q notes. Then Write-Output Latest on main: with $(git log -1 --format=%s), and the parent count as Parents: with $parents.
